name: ANSI/IEEE temperature switch nc symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for temperature switch nc, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The temperature-operated NC form marks a normally continuous path changed by its documented thermal condition. Its usefulness in heater, fan or trip logic depends on the threshold and reset information linked to the drawing.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Read manual versus automatic reset from the selected device.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: Contact polarity does not uniquely determine whether a circuit represents overheating or undertemperature.
